{{Quote|I hear you're giving even Chalmun's some competition."<br />"Yeah, well, times change. Business changes. My drinks are cheaper.|Han Solo and Shalo|<ref name="Rebirth" />}}
'''Shalo's Cantina''' was in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Rebirth" />

It was owned by [[Shalo]] who was ordered to Tatooine by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to manage one of their operations. It was where [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]][[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his son [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] met with Shalo to obtain some information regarding the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] traffic to [[Yuuzhan Vong]] occupied space.<ref name="Rebirth" />
